items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He liked Freddie Keppard's playing very much, more than anybody in New Orleans.

ctx.x: Did Oliver talk much about the early days in New Orleans to the younger musicians, like yourself, or even, say, Louis Metcalf or Elkins? Did he talk much about that period?
Well, he talked mostly about a trumpet player from New Orleans whose name was Freddie...Freddie Keppard.
